editorial_checks: The physical turtle-excluder mechanism is described without inventing a fishing household or projecting today's effectiveness figures and regulations into the 1990s.
The shrimp dispute stops at the 1996–2001 proceedings, not a claim about current WTO appellate operation. The 1998 conservation qualification and failure under the Article XX chapeau remain distinct.

The United States' domestic restrictions, local conditions, unequal adjustment periods, technological assistance and certification fairness all remain visible. No bad motive is inferred from procedural defects.
The 2001 ruling does not ban every unilateral environmental trade condition. Comparable effectiveness differs from an essentially identical programme; flexibility is not exemption from proof.

Serious, continuing good-faith negotiations are not a requirement to conclude an agreement or a one-off courtesy. Conditional compliance does not retroactively validate the original application or eliminate later review.
WTO member-government standing, influence on governments, discretionary amicus submissions and individual remedies are distinct. No personal lost-income award or ecological causal result is invented.
The Indus history stops at the 2013 awards. Signature, entry into force and retroactive effect are distinguished; later Bank role explanations are marked retrospective, not events in 2013.

The ad hoc seven-member Court of Arbitration, PCA secretariat, ICJ, Permanent Indus Commission, Neutral Expert and World Bank are not conflated. Procedures are not described as a mandatory appeal ladder.

The 2011 interim order does not stop all construction. The 2013 Partial Award recognizes conditional diversion, leaves the flow figure for further evidence and decides the reservoir-management issue separately.

The nine-cumec requirement is read with the daily-average upstream low-inflow condition: below nine, all that inflow is released. It is not an unconditional nine, a share of the whole Indus or a universal ecological flow.
The seven-year reconsideration period runs from diversion for generation, not the award date. Review is not automatic expiry, unilateral disregard or a finding that later review already occurred.

Monitoring is referred to the Commission and treaty mechanisms, not a newly established world water authority. Binding judgment, verification obligation and verified later performance remain separate.
Neither the treaty nor the awards are used to decide disputed territorial title. Residents' absence of party status in this interstate arbitration does not imply the failure of every domestic remedy.

No composite villagers, dialogue, private thoughts, resettlement outcomes, compensation receipts or post-cutoff treaty conclusions are invented. Historical facts, legal findings and the author's structural interpretation remain separate.
